title: Exploratory Data Analysis Of Hate Crimes In USA (1991-2020)
description:
This exploratory data analysis examines hate-crime records from across the USA between 1991 and 2020, working through three decades of data to extract meaningful insights and trends.

It uses SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow) to process and analyse the records, with Power BI used to visualise the findings.
